Physical examination reveals clubbing and bilateral crackles on chest auscultation. Chest X-ray reveals increased pulmonary markings and peripheral bronchi with a ‘tram track’ appearance. Which of the following pathophysiologies is responsible for the patient’s condition?

                    ### Question

Physical examination reveals clubbing and bilateral crackles on chest auscultation. Chest X-ray reveals increased pulmonary markings and peripheral bronchi with a ‘tram track’ appearance. Which of the following pathophysiologies is responsible for the patient’s condition?

                    ### Options

opb. Fibrosis of the lung parenchyma
